notes: Brand new PR, opened 2026-09-06T20:30:28Z by Alek99 (MEMBER). Part of the Sep 5-7 performance-PR batch; replaces the frontend event-queue's drain-and-rebuild prepend logic (repeated shift() calls) with a single unshift() of the filtered incoming events, cutting redundant array copies/traversal on the client. Backend/WebSocket protocol unchanged. Claims ~16-19% less prepend work in paired browser benchmarks.

Only CI-visible failure in the whole batch of six: 'integration-app-harness (redis, 3.11, 2)' failed, but reading the job log shows it never reached the actual tests — astral-sh/setup-uv's manifest fetch hit a transient `fetch failed` network error during setup, so UV/checkout never ran. All other redis/memory integration-app-harness shards passed. This looks like CI infra flakiness, not a real regression from this PR's diff; a re-run would likely go green.
